newsitem.title: USA: NFA suspends California commodity pool operator.
newsitem.headline: NFA suspends California commodity pool operator.

text.p: The National Futures Association (NFA) said it issued a member responsibility action against California-based commodity pool operator AC Trading Group Inc and an associate responsibility action against the firm's principal, Alexis Carles.
NFA, the U.S. futures industry's self-regulatory organization, said the actions effectively suspended AC Trading and Carles from futures-related business activity.
The association said it deemed the actions necessary to protect the commodity futures markets, customers and other NFA members.

NFA said it had reason to believe that AC Trading and Carles had acted as a futures commission merchant without being registered in that capacity, provided false account statements to customers and lied to NFA by representing that they had not conducted any customer business.
The actions will remain in effect until AC Trading and Carles have demonstrated to NFA that they are in compliance with all NFA requirements, the association said.
It added that AC Trading and Carles were entitled to a prompt hearing.
